TITLE: Transcript: Conversation With a Door
TEXT:
TRANSCRIPT (partial)

ME: Are you locked?
DOOR: I am closed.
ME: That's not the same.
DOOR: People confuse them.
ME: What do you want?
DOOR: A hand that doesn't slam.
ME: What do you keep inside?
DOOR: Air. Furniture. A person trying.
ME: Will you open if I knock?
DOOR: Will you stay if I do?

End of record.
Note: the hinge sounded like it remembered my name.
